en.headline: sogeisetsu opens a bug report and two idea discussions on openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-09, `sogeisetsu` recorded **0 own commits** across the day, with 21 additional automated commits in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` created by `github-actions[bot]`. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were produced. In `openchamber/openchamber`, the user opened issue #4601, titled "[Bug] Switching model in the composer keeps the previous thinking level instead of the model's own default", and later added a comment on the same issue. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied on #4601, noting that `defaultVariant` is a single global profile setting applied to every model offering that variant id, and tagged the issue `fix-ready`. The user also started two idea discussions in `openchamber/openchamber`: #4600, "[Idea] Let an extension expose something the agent can call, or document the file workflow", and #4599, "[Idea] Give agents a supported way to read and change OpenChamber settings (tool, CLI, or MCP)". Both discussions had 0 comments at the time of reporting.
